arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT=le001_1789265592
echo AUDIT_BACKEND_START=1
test -d "$APP" && test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"
sha="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'DEPLOY_SHA=%s\n' "$sha"
if test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"; then echo DEPLOY_WORKTREE=CLEAN; else echo DEPLOY_WORKTREE=DIRTY; fi
app_manage() {
 sudo -n bash -c '
 set -a
 . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
 set +a
 export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production
 cd /srv/lowcost-europa
 runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- .venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
 ' bash "$@"
}
app_manage check >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo DJANGO_CHECK=PASS
app_manage check --deploy >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo DJANGO_DEPLOY_CHECK=PASS
app_manage makemigrations --check --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo MIGRATION_DRIFT=NONE
app_manage shell -c '
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from django.conf import settings
from apps.catalog.models import Offer, OfferCandidate, ProductFamily, ExternalMetricsSnapshot
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
now=timezone.now()
print("DEBUG="+str(settings.DEBUG))
print("INDEXING="+str(settings.PUBLIC_INDEXING_ENABLED))
families=list(ProductFamily.objects.exclude(status=ProductFamily.Status.RETIRED).order_by("display_order","name","pk"))
print("FAMILIES="+str(len(families)))
eligible=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now),is_active=True,owner_hidden=False,family_placements__product_family__in=families).distinct()
print("OFFERS_TOTAL="+str(Offer.objects.count()))
print("OFFERS_ACTIVE="+str(Offer.objects.filter(is_active=True).count()))
print("OFFERS_ELIGIBLE="+str(eligible.count()))
print("ELIGIBLE_ORIGIN_UNPROVEN="+str(eligible.filter(Q(ship_from_country__isnull=True)|Q(ship_from_verified_at__isnull=True)).count()))
for f in families:
 n=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family=f,status=OfferCandidate.Status.PENDING).count()
 print("QUEUE="+str(f.slug)+";PENDING="+str(n)+";PAUSED="+str(int(n>=PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY)))
for source in ("ALIEXPRESS","META"):
 snap=ExternalMetricsSnapshot.objects.filter(source=source).first()
 state="missing" if snap is None else ("fresh" if snap.checked_at<=now and now-snap.checked_at<=timedelta(hours=12) else "stale")
 print("STORED_METRICS_"+source+"="+state)
print("DATABASE_READ=PASS")
'
echo AUDIT_BACKEND_END=PASS

set -Eeuo pipefail
BASE=https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
echo AUDIT_WEB_START=1
for svc in lowcost-europa.service nginx.service postgresql.service lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer; do
 if systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"; then echo "SERVICE_$svc=active"; else echo "SERVICE_$svc=NOT_ACTIVE"; fi
done
for p in / /health/live/ /health/ready/ /robots.txt /painel/ /pesquisar/?q=HIFU; do
 status="$(curl -sS -L --max-redirs 0 --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE$p" || true)"
 echo "HTTP_PATH=$p;STATUS=$status"
done
for slug in cavitacao-rf-vacuum-corpo hydrodermoabrasao-aqua-facial-multifuncoes pressoterapia-vacuum-drenagem hifu diodo-laser-remocao-tatuagens-pigmentacao; do
 status="$(curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE/products/$slug/" || true)"
 echo "FAMILY=$slug;HTTP=$status"
done
curl -fsS --max-time 15 -D /tmp/lowcost-audit-headers-$$ -o /dev/null "$BASE/"
if grep -qi '^x-robots-tag:.*noindex' /tmp/lowcost-audit-headers-$$; then echo X_ROBOTS_NOINDEX=PASS; else echo X_ROBOTS_NOINDEX=FAIL; fi
rm -f /tmp/lowcost-audit-headers-$$
if curl -fsS --max-time 15 "$BASE/robots.txt" | grep -Fq 'Disallow: /'; then echo ROBOTS_DISALLOW=PASS; else echo ROBOTS_DISALLOW=FAIL; fi
echo AUDIT_WEB_END=PASS

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo AUDIT_INFRA_START=1
for unit in lowcost-europa.service lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.timer lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.timer lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer nginx.service postgresql.service; do
 printf 'UNIT=%s;ACTIVE=%s;ENABLED=%s\n' "$unit" "$(systemctl is-active "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)" "$(systemctl is-enabled "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"
done
df -P /srv/lowcost-europa | tail -1 | awk '{print "DISK_USAGE_PERCENT="$5}'
echo AUDIT_INFRA_END=PASS
